scope.selection: Previous 56-file world sample plus non-rollback model/animation URLs declared in 17 served manifests, all 94 runtime-inferred tree LOD paths for their 47 declared variants, and 18 files from the six character-creation avatar registry options.

runtimeReceipt.purpose: Pins the current compact-island asset root, not a new active runtime or visible-asset census.

excluded: model-bounds metadata is not a runtime loading authority
diagnostic/session-selected avatar overrides not in the character-creation registry
arbitrary dynamic or network-supplied model URLs

acceptance: Declared asset inventory only. Existing per-file caps are provisional, not final per-role budgets. Includes alternatives and LODs that do not render together. The rock library is selected per variant/LOD by its runtime owner. No source model was changed. This is not decoded buffer validation, whole-launch coverage, actual GPU draws, resident memory or frame-time acceptance.
selectedSceneScope: Matches Three GLTFLoader's explicit scene or implicit scene 0. Primitive occurrences count node/primitive attachments; primitive-instance occurrences also multiply EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing. Material counts are source slots plus one implicit default. Runtime batching/library/LOD selection and material clones are separate.

findings.note: Served mining definitions omit LOD paths. ResourceSystem and InstancedModelVisualStrategy carry these as null, which disables LOD inference. The 18 absent optional ore LOD filenames are therefore not requested missing assets. The depleted-rock path loads only its supplied base model. Generating useful derived ore LODs and admitting their bindings remains separate work.
Selected station definitions have 23,904 and 22,866 declared triangles. Profile includes both station types. Verify placed populations and measured cost before selecting a reduction target.

Nine staff files each declare 29,646 triangles; two bait-fishing-rod files each declare 12,812. These include alternate fitted/aligned variants. Current filename-based category/limits remain provisional; avatar-specific runtime bindings are not equivalent to all declarations being active.
31,428 triangles across nine stored meshes. The runtime explicitly selects one variant/LOD per placement; do not attribute the full library to every rock.

Several NPC/mob VRMs are about 30 MB despite roughly 3,000 triangles. Lobster-pot variants have 82 source primitive attachments and four material slots; net variants have 46 and three. These are source facts, not actual native draw-call or resident-memory measurements.

Do not use models:optimize for this work: optimize-models-full.mjs still parses human-readable first-mesh output, mutates inputs in place and chooses Draco for static models. Current primary loaders configure Meshopt but not Draco. Replace with explicit source-to-derived-candidate processing and decoded/native verification; preserve originals.
